title: The skill gap between using AI and architecting AI.
summary: Summary withheld: an Opus review found that the machine-written summary did not match the post. Read the original post.

quotes.text: Using AI as a coding tool is not the same as architecting an AI application for a real business problem.
quotes.why_it_matters: Establishes the central distinction that most AI training focuses on tool usage rather than system-level design for production environments.

quotes.text: These aren't tips. They're architectural patterns.
quotes.why_it_matters: Clarifies that successful AI systems require formal design patterns similar to traditional systems architecture, not just best practice tips.
